leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the expected prop types for a functional component.
Implement default values for component props using ES6 default parameter syntax.
Utilize the defaultProps static property to assign fallback values for a class component.
Construct a functional component that accepts optional props with defined defaults.
Execute conditional rendering logic to display prop values or their defaults.
Define a component that uses default props to ensure consistent behavior when props are omitted.
Access and display prop values within JSX, demonstrating the precedence of passed props over defaults.
Modify a component's prop interface to mark certain properties as optional using the '?' operator.
Invoke a component in JSX both with and without specific props to observe default behavior.
Compare the usage of default parameters versus defaultProps for providing fallback values in React with TypeScript.
